title: T-hat-N: Matrix-constraint Spectral Analysis Framework - Rigid Ball-Arithmetic Kernel, Interval Newton Zeta Inversion, and Certified Dirichlet Bracketing
description: Executable research software for the Matrix-constraint Spectral Analysis Framework (MSAF). A rigid computational kernel built on python-flint ball arithmetic (Arb/Acb, 256-bit working precision) with zero floating-point hand-offs: a finite information lattice (N_steps = D_obs / l_P), unitary cyclic-shift operator certificates, Guinand-Weil spectral analysis, rigorous interval Newton inversion of the Riemann xi function, SHA-256 hash-chained evolution ledgers with independent replay, rigid cosmological pixel projection, and certified Hardy sign-change bracketing for real primitive Dirichlet characters. Every zero claim is certified by interval containment, never by equality. Includes an 85-test regression suite pinning 38 documented precision landmines, machine-readable evidence ledgers, and a formal 16-row measurement table in the README.
